audit.why: Pantheon 1 / Skill 2 / Shen 3-4 / Pantheon 6 / Shen at both item stages. Both layers agree, and it fits a 50.09% win rate over 1174 games — a genuinely even lane that tilts to Shen once he itemizes.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the level-6 spike said only that 'both ults are macro'.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s at 600 range and Stand United is 200/180/160s. An 18-second engage cooldown at rank 1 is the widest punish window in the lane and it was never stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'never dump an empowered Q into an active W' — this is backwards. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities, so an empowered Comet Spear is exactly what you SHOULD send through it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Attacks, not spells. The current advice tells the player to hold their best damage for no reason and to keep auto-attacking, which is the one thing the zone does stop.
audit.corrected: Reversed: bait it with a throwaway auto, keep casting through it, and stop feeding it basic attacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stand United was never named, and the fact that you can cancel it was never mentioned.
audit.why: Stand United is a channel — Shen shields an ally and only teleports 'soon after'. Shield Vault is a 600-range point-click stun. Cancelling a 200-second global is the single highest-value thing Pantheon does in this matchup, and the _missing-interactions file flags it for exactly this pairing.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2], mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ki Barrier and Twilight Assault were never named; 'his passive sustain' was the only reference.
audit.why: Ki Barrier is a shield after every spell cast, with its cooldown reduced by hitting champions — so he is shielded far more often than 'sustain' suggests. Twilight Assault deals damage based on your max health, which is why stacking HP is not the answer to him.
audit.corrected: Both named in whys[3], whys[6], spikes[3], mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said the Shadow Dash taunt ends Aegis Assault.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a channel and Shadow Dash taunts — hard CC on a 600-range dash. Holding the shield while his E is up loses the trade outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright' in phases[0].why and breakdown.early.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will. The shield is Aegis Assault (E), 22s, front-only, and a channel.

edits.before: Shen is one of the few tanks you can actually push around at levels 1-3 — you out-stat him at 1 and your Lvl 2 W-stun spike lands before his E taunt comes up. The trick is his W: it auto-blocks your basic attacks, so never dump an empowered Q into an active W. Tap a throwaway Q to bait the block, watch the shimmer drop, then commit W-Q empower and use your E to eat his return autos. Just respect his E dash range — if you W in carelessly he taunts you and the trade flips.
edits.after: Shen is one of the few tanks you can push around at levels 1-3 — you out-stat him at 1 and your level-2 Shield Vault spike lands before Shadow Dash comes up. The trick is Spirit's Refuge: it blocks attacks, not abilities, so an empowered Comet Spear still lands straight through it — what you must not do is feed it basic attacks. Tap a throwaway auto to bait it, watch the shimmer drop, then commit W into empowered Q. Respect Shadow Dash at 600: it taunts, and a taunt cancels Aegis Assault mid-channel.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 the lane settles. You still have empowered-Q poke and E to block his Q-empowered autos, but Shen's passive sustain and innate tankiness mean your chunks don't stick the way they do on a squishy. At 6 both ults are map tools, not duel tools — your Grand Starfall wants to leave lane and snowball other lanes, while his global R answers yours, so neither of you wins the 1v1 outright. Make your tempo count somewhere else on the map.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 the lane settles. You still have empowered-Q poke, but Ki Barrier re-shields him after every single cast and Twilight Assault chips you for max health, so your chunks do not stick the way they do on a squishy. At 6 both ults are map tools — except Stand United is a channel on a 200-second cooldown at rank 1, and your Shield Vault cancels it outright. Reach him as he casts and you delete a global teleport and a shield in one dash.

edits.before: This is where Shen quietly wins. Your damage plateaus while he stacks tank items, his W keeps eating your key autos, and his sustain lets him survive every all-in you used to win in lane. You can't burst a 3k-HP Shen with empowered Q the way you bullied him at level 2. Close the game on the lead you built early — get plates, get roams, get objectives — because if it goes long, he out-scales and out-utilities you with R every fight.
edits.after: This is where Shen quietly wins. Your damage plateaus while he stacks tank items, Ki Barrier re-shields on every cast, and Twilight Assault's max-health damage scales off your team rather than his gold. You cannot burst a 3k-HP Shen the way you bullied him at level 2. Close on the lead you built early — plates, roams, objectives — and in fights hunt the Stand United cast: your W cancels the channel and strands the ally he was saving.

notes: The headline correction is a reversal, not a rewording. The page said 'never dump an empowered Q into an active W'. Riot's Spirit's Refuge text is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — attacks, not abilities. So the correct play is the opposite of what was written: keep casting through the zone and stop auto-attacking into it. A Pantheon holding his empowered Comet Spear for the shimmer to drop is throwing away the trade for nothing. Second, the matchup never named Stand United and never mentioned that it is a channel. Shield Vault is a 600-range point-click stun and Shen's ultimate is 200 seconds at rank 1 — cancelling it is the highest-value single action in the pairing and both this file and _missing-interactions flagged it. Ki Barrier was also missing: it re-shields after EVERY spell cast, not merely as 'passive sustain', which is why extended chip does so little to him. Twilight Assault's damage is based on the target's max health, so stacking HP against Shen is the wrong answer — worth carrying into the itemization line if anyone revisits point 10 here.
